initialExam.title: SSC Selection Post Phase XIV 2026
initialExam.description: Selection Posts Phase XIV exam for various Group B and C posts at Matriculation, Higher Secondary, and Graduation levels. Application closed; CBE exam in June 2026.
initialExam.syllabus: General Intelligence, English Language, Quantitative Aptitude, General Awareness. Level varies by post category.
initialExam.examPattern: CBT: 100 questions, 200 marks, 60 minutes. Separate exam for each level (Matric/HS/Grad).
initialExam.jobRole: Various posts in different central government departments
initialExam.careerGrowth: Depends on the specific post selected. Promotion through departmental channels.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ssc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Select eligible posts 4. Fill form 5. Pay fee 6. Submit

salaryRange.description: Pay Level 1 to 6 depending on post

posts: Various central government posts at different levels
